content: The user asks to provide SMILES of the organic compound sample. We have no data about the sample. We need to analyze using tools: maybe we have spectra data? The available tools include mass_spectrometry_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, carbon_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra, hsqc_nmr_spectra, etc. But we need to know which sample? The prompt says "In the lab, you've received a sample of an organic compound. Perform a careful analysis and provide the SMILES code, using only the necessary time and materials." But we have no actual data. Perhaps there is hidden data in the environment? The tool functions may retrieve spectra for "the sample at hand". So calling proton_nmr_spectra without arguments may give us the spectrum. Let's try that.
